definitions.explanation: An exhibition of paintings, sculpture, crafts, or other works of art, whether a museum show or a juried exhibition that artists submit work to.

examples.japanese: {美術展|びじゅつてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see an art exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{美術展|びじゅつてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入選|にゅうせん}→入選：11686_nyuusen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My daughter's painting was accepted for an art exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美術展|びじゅつてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At a popular art exhibition, you sometimes have to queue for as long as an hour to get in on weekends.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (fine art) + ⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧ (exhibition). ⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧ attaches to many nouns to name shows: {写真展|しゃしんてん} (photo exhibition), ⟦{個展|こてん}→個展：15068_koten⟧ (solo exhibition).
